# mvtnorm deterministic QMC branch

`mvtnorm` computes multivariate normal and t probabilities, quantiles, random
deviates, and densities. This repository is a development branch based on the
CRAN mirror of `mvtnorm` and explores deterministic quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC)
alternatives for multivariate normal probabilities.

## Core package functions

- `pmvnorm()`: multivariate normal probabilities.
- `pmvt()`: multivariate t probabilities.
- `qmvnorm()` and `qmvt()`: quantiles.
- `dmvnorm()`, `rmvnorm()`, `dmvt()`, `rmvt()`: densities and random deviates.
- `GenzBretz()`, `Miwa()`, `TVPACK()`: existing algorithm selectors.
- `DeterministicQMC()`: new deterministic QMC algorithm selector on this
  branch.

## New deterministic algorithm selector

`DeterministicQMC(maxpts = 25000, abseps = 0.001, releps = 0, backend = "auto")`
adds reproducible deterministic integration paths. Available backends are:

- `"auto"`: automatic deterministic policy.
- `"c"`: plain C Halton backend for normal probabilities.
- `"sobol"`: plain C Sobol backend for normal probabilities.
- `"hybrid"`: Sobol backend with deterministic tail-spaced transformation.
- `"genzsobol"`: Sobol backend with variable reordering and embedded stability
  checks.
- `"fortran"`: original FORTRAN path with deterministic shifts.
- `"cpu"`: alias for `"c"`.
- `"metal"`: probes for macOS Metal but currently falls back because no Metal
  evaluator is implemented.

For supported normal probabilities, `backend = "auto"` runs repeated
Genz-Sobol checks at fixed deterministic sequence offsets and reports the
larger of embedded stability errors and between-check spread. Unsupported
cases use the deterministic FORTRAN path.

## Error diagnostics

The deterministic `error` attribute is a reproducible stability diagnostic.
Positive `abseps` and `releps` request that this diagnostic meet the requested
target before `maxpts` is exhausted. These diagnostics are not Monte Carlo
confidence intervals and not rigorous deterministic error bounds.

## Important files

- `R/mvt.R`: R algorithm selectors and deterministic backend dispatch.
- `src/dqmc.c`: deterministic C QMC backends.
- `src/C_FORTRAN_interface.c`: deterministic FORTRAN random-number hook and
  Metal availability probe.
- `src/mvtnorm-init.c`: native routine registration.
- `man/algorithms.Rd`: algorithm help documentation.
- `vignettes/articles/dqmc-methods.Rmd`: methodology article.
- `vignettes/articles/dqmc-benchmark.Rmd`: speed and relative-error benchmark.
- `vignettes/DeterministicQMC-methods.Rnw`: Sweave methodology vignette.
- `vignettes/DeterministicQMC-benchmark.Rnw`: Sweave benchmark vignette.
- `tests/regtest-DeterministicQMC.R`: deterministic QMC regression tests.
- `docs/`: pkgdown site.

## Suggested local validation

```sh
R CMD INSTALL -l /tmp/mvtnorm-lib .
R_LIBS=/tmp/mvtnorm-lib Rscript tests/regtest-DeterministicQMC.R
R CMD check --no-manual --no-build-vignettes -o /tmp/mvtnorm-check .
```

The pkgdown site also generates a more complete function index at
`docs/llms.txt`.
